source.anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Weak marginal evolution from sphere diffusion rows. Exact assumptions and formula below.
source.original_text:
Use the actual laws $\rho_t=(X_t)_\#P$. Put $F(t)=\int f(w)\,d\rho_{t^+}(w)$ and $B(t)=\int\mathcal L_{t^+}f(w)\,d\rho_{t^+}(w)$. The generator average $B$ is locally integrable on the real line. The expectation $F$ is absolutely continuous on each finite nonnegative interval and has the signed two-time balance and almost-everywhere derivative below.

The sample space carries a probability measure $P$, a filtration indexed by nonnegative real time satisfying the usual conditions, and a standard Euclidean Brownian motion relative to that filtration. The coordinate set $I$ is finite with decidable equality.
The process $X$ is jointly measurable and takes values in the Euclidean unit sphere $S$. The field $u(t,w)$ is jointly continuous and ambient-vector-valued.
The deterministic temperature $\lambda$ is Borel measurable, nonnegative at each time, and bounded pointwise on each finite horizon. The ambient real test $f$ is $C^2$ at every point of $S$.
For each strictly positive horizon, supply initialized coordinates strongly measurable in $\mathcal F_0$, strongly progressive drift rows with almost-sure integrable sections, and strongly progressive product-$L^2$ noise rows. Their initialized integral equation agrees with $X$ almost surely simultaneously for all horizon times. On the corresponding full-measure events the drift is $-u(t,X_t)-\lambda(t)(|I|-1)X_t$ and each noise column is $\sqrt{2\lambda(t)}P_{X_t}e_j$ throughout the horizon.
Here $P_we_j=e_j-w_jw$ and $t^+=\max(t,0)$. Both endpoints in the signed balance are arbitrary nonnegative times.
The sphere generator is $\mathcal L_t f(w)=-Df(w)[u(t,w)]+\lambda(t)\Delta_S^{\mathrm{ext}}f(w)$, with $\Delta_S^{\mathrm{ext}}f(w)=\sum_j D^2f(w)[P_we_j,P_we_j]-(|I|-1)Df(w)[w]$.

F(b)-F(a)=\int_a^b B(v)\,dv,\qquad F'(t)=B(t)\quad\text{for Lebesgue-a.e. }t>0.

theorem anonymous_target.{u_1,
    u_2}
  {Ω : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  {filtration : MeasureTheory.Filtration NNReal inferInstance} (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  {B : NNReal → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ I}
  (hB :
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.BrownianMotion.IsStandardBrownianMotionWithFiltration B
      filtration ↑P)
  (hUsual : AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration ↑P)
  (X : NNReal → Ω → ↑(Metric.sphere 0 1)) (hX : Measurable (Function.uncurry X))
  (u : NNReal → ↑(Metric.sphere 0 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ I) (hu : Continuous (Function.uncurry u))
  (temperature : NNReal → ℝ) (hTemperature : Measurable temperature)
  (hTemperatureBound : ∀ (T : NNReal), ∃ C, ∀ t ≤ T, ‖temperature t‖ ≤ C) (hNonneg : ∀ (t : NNReal), 0 ≤ temperature t)
  (hEquation :
    ∀ (T : NNReal) (hT : 0 < T),
      ∃ η x b,
        (∀ (i : I), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable fun ω => x ω i) ∧
          (∀ (i : I), MeasureTheory.IsStronglyProgressive filtration (b i)) ∧
            (∀ (i : I),
                ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P,
                  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => b i t ω)
                    (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T)) ∧
              (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P,
                  ∀ t ≤ T,
                    (WithLp.toLp 2 fun i =>
                        x ω i +
                            AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveDriftIntegral.prefixIntegralProcess
                              (b i) t ω +
                          ∑ j,
                            AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoIntegralProcess.itoIntegralProcess
                              (η i j) hT ⋯ hUsual t ω) =
                      ↑(X t ω)) ∧
                (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P,
                    ∀ t ≤ T,
                      (WithLp.toLp 2 fun i => b i t ω) =
                        -u t (X t ω) - (temperature t * ↑(Fintype.card I - 1)) • ↑(X t ω)) ∧
                  ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P,
                    ∀ t ≤ T,
                      ∀ (j : I),
                        (WithLp.toLp 2 fun i => (η i j).process t ω) =
                          √(2 * temperature t) •
                            local_symbol_235fd8b746d6 j
                              ↑(X t ω))
  (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ I → ℝ) (hf : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere 0 1, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f w) :
  let S := Metric.sphere 0 1;
  have hSlice := ⋯;
  have ρ := fun t => P.map ⋯;
  have F := fun t => ∫ (w : ↑S), f ↑w ∂↑(ρ t.toNNReal);
  have B := fun t =>
    ∫ (w : ↑S),
      -(fderiv ℝ f ↑w) (u t.toNNReal w) +
        temperature t.toNNReal *
          local_symbol_e27025fd0d42 f ↑w ∂↑(ρ t.toNNReal);
  MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable B MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume ∧
    (∀ (a b : NNReal), F ↑b - F ↑a = ∫ (v : ℝ) in ↑a..↑b, B v) ∧
      (∀ (T : NNReal), AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval F 0 ↑T) ∧
        ∀ᵐ (t : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi 0), HasDerivAt F (B t) t

Objects: Put d=card(I), c=real(max(d-1,0)) (natural-number subtraction before casting), E=R^I with Euclidean norm, S={x in E: ||x||=1}, V_j(x)=e_j-x_j*x, and L_S f(x)=Laplacian(f)(x)-D^2 f(x)[x,x]-c*Df(x)[x]. Here Df is the Frechet derivative and D^2 f=D(Df). Write R_+=[0,infinity), and let lambda_T be Lebesgue measure on [0,T], transported to R_+ (the given comap of volume restricted to [0,T]). All time integrals below use this measure unless indicated otherwise. A ProgressiveL2Integrand eta on horizon T is a real process eta(t,omega), strongly progressive for the filtration, with (omega,t) -> eta(t,omega) in L^2(P x lambda_T). I_T^j(eta) denotes the supplied completed continuous Ito process driven by the scalar coordinate B_j(t,omega)=(B(t,omega))_j: the pointwise limit of chosen elementary stochastic-integral approximations off their null uniform-Cauchy bad set, zero on that bad set, and held constant after T; at each t<=T it agrees almost everywhere with the L^2-completion integral up to t. Let rho(t)=(X(t,.))_*P be the law on S obtained by mapping P under X(t,.). Put F(r)=integral_S f(w)d rho(max(r,0)) and G(r)=integral_S [-Df(w)[u(max(r,0),w)]+a(max(r,0))*L_S f(w)]d rho(max(r,0)). The integrand's toLp operation is its L^2 equivalence class represented by (omega,t)->eta(t,omega).

Domains: Omega measurable; I finite with decidable equality; E,S as above; P probability; filtration indexed by R_+; B:R_+ x Omega -> E; X:R_+ x Omega -> S; u:R_+ x S -> E; a:R_+ -> R; f:E -> R. F,G have domain all real numbers.

Quantifiers: Universally Omega,I,structures,filtration,P,B and Brownian/usual hypotheses; X,hX; u,hu; a,measurability,local bound,nonnegativity; equation; f,hf. The equation has order: for every T>0 there exist eta,x,b, then all listed conjuncts. eta,x,b may depend on T. Conclusions quantify independently over all a0,b0>=0 and all T>=0, then almost every positive real t.

Assumptions: The vector Brownian hypothesis means B(0,omega)=0 for every omega; increments on finite families of pairwise disjoint half-open intervals are jointly independent; every continuous real linear functional ell sends B(t)-B(s), s<t, to a centered Gaussian of variance (t-s)||ell||^2; paths are P-almost surely continuous. B is strongly adapted, and for every s<=t the increment B(t)-B(s) is independent of the sigma-algebra filtration(s). The filtration is right continuous, and every P-null subset of Omega belongs to filtration(t) for every t>=0 (completeness at each time). X is jointly measurable. u is jointly continuous. Temperature a is measurable, everywhere nonnegative, and for each T>=0 there is a real C_T with |a(t)|<=C_T for all t<=T. For every T>0 there exist eta_ij in ProgressiveL2Integrand(filtration,P,T), x:Omega->R^I and b_i:R_+ x Omega->R such that each x_i is strongly measurable with respect to filtration(0), each b_i is strongly progressive, each b_i(.,omega) is lambda_T-integrable for P-a.e. omega, and the following three pathwise identities hold P-a.e., each uniformly for t<=T: X_i(t)=x_i+integral_0^t b_i(v)dv+sum_j I_T^j(eta_ij)(t); b(t)=-u(t,X(t))-a(t)*c*X(t); for every j, (eta_ij(t))_i=sqrt(2*a(t))*V_j(X(t)). f is C^2 at every point of S. No separate progressive or continuous-path assumption on X is listed.

Conclusion: G is locally integrable with respect to Lebesgue measure on all R; for every a0,b0 in R_+, F(b0)-F(a0)=integral_{a0}^{b0} G(v)dv with the oriented interval integral; for every T in R_+, F is absolutely continuous on [0,T]; and for Lebesgue-a.e. t in (0,infinity), F is differentiable at t with derivative G(t).

Scopes: Global local integrability includes negative arguments because max(r,0) extends the coefficients and rho. The integral identity has no ordering condition a0<=b0. Absolute continuity is for every finite nonnegative horizon including zero. Derivative is almost everywhere on the open positive half-line, not asserted at zero. Three equation events may be intersected for a fixed T; no one-event-for-all-T assertion is given.

Constant dependencies: Each temperature bound C_T may depend on T and a. Witnesses eta,x,b depend on the preceding data and T. F and G depend on the laws rho(t)=(X(t,.))_*P; no additional constants are quantified.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SphereItoIntegratedRows
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasureRealBridge
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.WeakMeasurableEvolution

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SphereMeasurableWeakForward

open Filter MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set
open scoped BigOperators NNReal
open BrownianMotion ProgressiveL2 EuclideanBrownianCoordinates ItoIntegralProcess
  ProgressiveDriftIntegral SphereItoIntegratedRows TimeMeasureRealBridge WeakMeasurableEvolution
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Geometry.SphereProjectedNoise
  AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Geometry.SphereDiffusionGenerator

/-- A sphere-valued process with the specified integrated Brownian equations
on each positive horizon satisfies the weak marginal integral balance and
an almost-everywhere derivative for a locally bounded measurable temperature. -/
theorem sphere_marginal_balance_of_measurable_temperature_rows
    {Ω I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    {filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Ω)}
    (P : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ I}
    (hB : IsStandardBrownianMotionWithFiltration B filtration (P : Measure Ω))
    (hUsual : SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration (P : Measure Ω))
    (X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 1)
    (hX : Measurable (Function.uncurry X))
    (u : ℝ≥0 → Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 1 → EuclideanSpace ℝ I)
    (hu : Continuous (Function.uncurry u))
    (temperature : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) (hTemperature : Measurable temperature)
    (hTemperatureBound : ∀ T : ℝ≥0, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ≤ T, ‖temperature t‖ ≤ C)
    (hNonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ temperature t)
    (hEquation : ∀ (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T),
      ∃ (η : I → I → ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration (P : Measure Ω) T)
        (x : Ω → I → ℝ) (b : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ),
        (∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[filtration 0] (fun ω => x ω i)) ∧
        (∀ i, IsStronglyProgressive filtration (b i)) ∧
        (∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : Measure Ω), Integrable (fun t => b i t ω) (TimeMeasure.upTo T)) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : Measure Ω), ∀ t ≤ T,
          (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : I => x ω i + prefixIntegralProcess (b i) t ω +
            ∑ j : I, itoIntegralProcess (η i j) hT ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian j) hUsual t ω) :
              EuclideanSpace ℝ I) = (X t ω : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : Measure Ω), ∀ t ≤ T, WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => b i t ω) =
          -u t (X t ω) - (temperature t * ((Fintype.card I - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) •
            (X t ω : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : Measure Ω), ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ j : I, WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (η i j).process t ω) =
          Real.sqrt (2 * temperature t) • projectedNoiseColumn j (X t ω)))
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ I → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 1, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f w)
    :
    let S := Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 1
    let hSlice (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (X t) := hX.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
    let ρ (t : ℝ≥0) := P.map (hSlice t).aemeasurable
    let F (t : ℝ) := ∫ w : S, f w ∂(ρ t.toNNReal : Measure S)
    let B (t : ℝ) := ∫ w : S, -fderiv ℝ f w (u t.toNNReal w) +
      temperature t.toNNReal * sphereLaplacian f w ∂(ρ t.toNNReal : Measure S)
    LocallyIntegrable B volume ∧
      (∀ a b : ℝ≥0, F b - F a = ∫ v in (a : ℝ)..(b : ℝ), B v) ∧
      (∀ T : ℝ≥0, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval F 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)), HasDerivAt F (B t) t) := by
  intro S hSlice ρ F B
  obtain ⟨ω₀⟩ := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure (P : Measure Ω)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ I
  have : CompactSpace S := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_sphere _ _)
  let A (t : ℝ≥0) (w : S) : ℝ :=
    -fderiv ℝ f w (u t w) + temperature t * sphereLaplacian f w
  have hg : Continuous (fun w : S => f (w : E)) := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun w =>
    (hf w w.property).continuousAt.comp continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt
  have hD : Continuous (fun w : S => fderiv ℝ f (w : E)) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun w =>
      ((hf w w.property).continuousAt_fderiv (by decide)).comp continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt
  have hH : Continuous (fun w : S => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (w : E)) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun w =>
      (((hf w w.property).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by decide)).continuousAt_fderiv
        (by decide)).comp continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt
  have hTrace : Continuous (fun w : S => ∑ j : I,
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (w : E) (projectedNoiseColumn j w) (projectedNoiseColumn j w)) := by
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro j _
    let L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := PiLp.proj (p := 2) (𝕜 := ℝ) (β := fun _ : I => ℝ) j
    have hp : Continuous (fun w : S => projectedNoiseColumn j (w : E)) :=
      continuous_const.sub ((L.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).smul continuous_subtype_val)
    exact (hH.clm_apply hp).clm_apply hp
  have hLap : Continuous (fun w : S => sphereLaplacian f (w : E)) := by
    refine (hTrace.sub ((continuous_const (y := ((Fintype.card I - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))).mul
      (hD.clm_apply continuous_subtype_val))).congr ?_
    intro w
    change (∑ j : I, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (w : E)
      (projectedNoiseColumn j w) (projectedNoiseColumn j w)) -
      ((Fintype.card I - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * fderiv ℝ f (w : E) (w : E) = _
    rw [sum_hessian_projectedNoiseColumn f (mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.1 w.property)]
    rfl
  let drift (q : ℝ≥0 × S) := -fderiv ℝ f (q.2 : E) (u q.1 q.2)
  have hDriftCont : Continuous drift := ((hD.comp continuous_snd).clm_apply hu).neg
  have hA : Measurable (Function.uncurry A) :=
    hDriftCont.measurable.add ((hTemperature.comp measurable_fst).mul
      (hLap.measurable.comp measurable_snd))
  have hBound (T : ℝ≥0) : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ w, ‖A t w‖ ≤ C := by
    have hcompact : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ≥0) T ×ˢ (univ : Set S)) :=
      isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_univ
    obtain ⟨C₁, h₁⟩ := hcompact.bddAbove_image hDriftCont.norm.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨C₂, h₂⟩ := (isCompact_univ (X := S)).bddAbove_image hLap.norm.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨C₃, h₃⟩ := hTemperatureBound T
    have h₃pos : 0 ≤ C₃ := (norm_nonneg _).trans (h₃ 0 bot_le)
    refine ⟨C₁ + C₃ * C₂, fun t ht w => ?_⟩
    calc
      ‖A t w‖ ≤ ‖drift (t, w)‖ + ‖temperature t‖ * ‖sphereLaplacian f (w : E)‖ := by
        dsimp only [A, drift]
        simpa only [norm_mul] using norm_add_le
          (-fderiv ℝ f (w : E) (u t w)) (temperature t * sphereLaplacian f (w : E))
      _ ≤ C₁ + C₃ * C₂ :=
        add_le_add (h₁ ⟨(t,w), ⟨⟨bot_le, ht⟩, mem_univ w⟩, rfl⟩)
          (mul_le_mul (h₃ t ht) (h₂ ⟨w, mem_univ w, rfl⟩) (norm_nonneg _) h₃pos)
  apply marginal_balance_of_locally_bounded_generator P X hX
    (fun w : S => f (w : E)) hg A hA hBound
  intro T
  by_cases hT : T = 0
  · subst T
    exact ⟨0, integrable_zero Ω ℝ _, integral_zero _ _,
      Eventually.of_forall fun _ => by simp⟩
  have hPos : 0 < T := bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr hT
  obtain ⟨η, x, b, hx, hb, hbi, hEq, hbEq, hηEq⟩ := hEquation T hPos
  let Y (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : E := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : I =>
    x ω i + prefixIntegralProcess (b i) t ω +
      ∑ j : I, itoIntegralProcess (η i j) hPos ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian j) hUsual t ω)
  have hYEq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : Measure Ω), ∀ t ≤ T, Y t ω = (X t ω : E) := hEq
  have hSphere : ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : Measure Ω), ∀ t ≤ T, Y t ω ∈ S :=
    hYEq.mono fun ω heq t ht => (heq t ht).symm ▸ (X t ω).property
  have hDrift : ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : Measure Ω), ∀ t ≤ T, WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => b i t ω) =
      -u t (X t ω) - (temperature t * ((Fintype.card I - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) • Y t ω := by
    filter_upwards [hYEq, hbEq] with ω heq hcoeff t ht
    rw [heq t ht]
    exact hcoeff t ht
  have hColumns : ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : Measure Ω), ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ j : I,
      WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (η i j).process t ω) =
      Real.sqrt (2 * temperature t) • projectedNoiseColumn j (Y t ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hYEq, hηEq] with ω heq hcoeff t ht j
    rw [heq t ht]
    exact hcoeff t ht j
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hM0, hIto⟩ := ito_formula_sphere_of_integrated_rows hB hPos hUsual η x hx b hb hbi
    (X 0 ω₀) f hf (fun t ω => u t (X t ω)) temperature
    (fun t _ => hNonneg t) hSphere hDrift hColumns
  have hmean := hM.setIntegral_eq (show 0 ≤ T from bot_le) MeasurableSet.univ
  rw [Measure.restrict_univ] at hmean
  simp only [hM0, integral_zero] at hmean
  refine ⟨M T, hM.integrable T, hmean.symm, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hYEq, hIto] with ω heq hω
  change f (Y T ω) - f (Y 0 ω) =
    (∫ t, -fderiv ℝ f (Y t ω) (u t (X t ω)) + temperature t * sphereLaplacian f (Y t ω)
      ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)) + M T ω at hω
  rw [heq T le_rfl, heq 0 bot_le] at hω
  rw [hω]
  apply congrArg (· + M T ω)
  calc
    _ = ∫ t, A t (X t ω) ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [TimeMeasure.ae_mem_Ioc_zero_upTo T] with t ht
      simp only [heq t ht.2, A]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← TimeMeasure.restrict_upTo_Ioc_zero T,
        integral_upTo_restrict_Ioc_eq_real (fun t => A t (X t ω)) (show 0 ≤ T from bot_le) le_rfl]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro r hr
      change r ∈ uIcc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ) at hr
      rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hr
      simp only [realZeroExtension, if_pos hr.1]

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SphereMeasurableWeakForward

Their initialized integral equation agrees with $X$ almost surely simultaneously for all horizon times. On the corresponding full-measure events the drift is $-u(t,X_t)-\lambda(t)(|I|-1)X_t$ and each noise column is $\sqrt{2\lambda(t)}P_{X_t}e_j$ throughout the horizon.
Here $P_we_j=e_j-w_jw$ and $t^+=\max(t,0)$. Both endpoints in the signed balance are arbitrary nonnegative times.
The sphere generator is $\mathcal L_t f(w)=-Df(w)[u(t,w)]+\lambda(t)\Delta_S^{\mathrm{ext}}f(w)$, with $\Delta_S^{\mathrm{ext}}f(w)=\sum_j D^2f(w)[P_we_j,P_we_j]-(|I|-1)Df(w)[w]$.

steps.title: Bound the generator on compact horizons
steps.text: The derivative weights and continuous field give uniform bounds on the compact state and time sets. Multiply the Laplacian bound by the horizon bound for the Borel temperature.
steps.lean:
let drift (q : ℝ≥0 × S) := -fderiv ℝ f (q.2 : E) (u q.1 q.2)
  have hDriftCont : Continuous drift := ((hD.comp continuous_snd).clm_apply hu).neg
  have hA : Measurable (Function.uncurry A) :=
    hDriftCont.measurable.add ((hTemperature.comp measurable_fst).mul
      (hLap.measurable.comp measurable_snd))
  have hBound (T : ℝ≥0) : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ w, ‖A t w‖ ≤ C := by
    have hcompact : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ≥0) T ×ˢ (univ : Set S)) :=
      isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_univ
    obtain ⟨C₁, h₁⟩ := hcompact.bddAbove_image hDriftCont.norm.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨C₂, h₂⟩ := (isCompact_univ (X := S)).bddAbove_image hLap.norm.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨C₃, h₃⟩ := hTemperatureBound T
    have h₃pos : 0 ≤ C₃ := (norm_nonneg _).trans (h₃ 0 bot_le)
    refine ⟨C₁ + C₃ * C₂, fun t ht w => ?_⟩
    calc
      ‖A t w‖ ≤ ‖drift (t, w)‖ + ‖temperature t‖ * ‖sphereLaplacian f (w : E)‖ := by
        dsimp only [A, drift]
        simpa only [norm_mul] using norm_add_le
          (-fderiv ℝ f (w : E) (u t w)) (temperature t * sphereLaplacian f (w : E))
      _ ≤ C₁ + C₃ * C₂ :=
        add_le_add (h₁ ⟨(t,w), ⟨⟨bot_le, ht⟩, mem_univ w⟩, rfl⟩)
          (mul_le_mul (h₃ t ht) (h₂ ⟨w, mem_univ w, rfl⟩) (norm_nonneg _) h₃pos)
steps.detail: Use continuity of the derivative restrictions and the bound on temperature.

steps.title: Center the terminal increment
steps.text: The horizon-specific rows satisfy the sphere Itô formula. The martingale has expectation zero at the terminal time because it starts at zero. Convert the restricted nonnegative time integral into the real interval integral.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨M, hM, hM0, hIto⟩ := ito_formula_sphere_of_integrated_rows hB hPos hUsual η x hx b hb hbi
    (X 0 ω₀) f hf (fun t ω => u t (X t ω)) temperature
    (fun t _ => hNonneg t) hSphere hDrift hColumns
  have hmean := hM.setIntegral_eq (show 0 ≤ T from bot_le) MeasurableSet.univ
  rw [Measure.restrict_univ] at hmean
  simp only [hM0, integral_zero] at hmean
  refine ⟨M T, hM.integrable T, hmean.symm, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hYEq, hIto] with ω heq hω
  change f (Y T ω) - f (Y 0 ω) =
    (∫ t, -fderiv ℝ f (Y t ω) (u t (X t ω)) + temperature t * sphereLaplacian f (Y t ω)
      ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)) + M T ω at hω
  rw [heq T le_rfl, heq 0 bot_le] at hω
  rw [hω]
  apply congrArg (· + M T ω)
  calc
    _ = ∫ t, A t (X t ω) ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [TimeMeasure.ae_mem_Ioc_zero_upTo T] with t ht
      simp only [heq t ht.2, A]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← TimeMeasure.restrict_upTo_Ioc_zero T,
        integral_upTo_restrict_Ioc_eq_real (fun t => A t (X t ω)) (show 0 ≤ T from bot_le) le_rfl]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro r hr
      change r ∈ uIcc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ) at hr
      rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hr
      simp only [realZeroExtension, if_pos hr.1]

steps.title: Use the marginal balance theorem
steps.text: The centered increment applies at each terminal time. At time zero the increment and integral are both zero. The general marginal theorem gives the stated regularity and balance.
steps.lean:
apply marginal_balance_of_locally_bounded_generator P X hX
    (fun w : S => f (w : E)) hg A hA hBound
  intro T
  by_cases hT : T = 0
  · subst T
    exact ⟨0, integrable_zero Ω ℝ _, integral_zero _ _,
      Eventually.of_forall fun _ => by simp⟩
